invariants: No claim, evidence, endpoint, requirement finding, gap, strongest supported claim, prohibited inference, or historical bounded decision may be deleted.
The original applicability and finding_status values for all 78 requirements remain unchanged.
The exact legacy bounded decision is copied into legacy_bounded_decision.
New structured fields may be populated from explicit source content or set to an unresolved state; inference is not presented as source fact.
A migration-generated conformance decision may record mechanical blockers but does not replace the historical bounded decision.

field_actions.rule: Derive current use states conservatively from exact assessed context; all material future uses become reopening gates.
Create typed claim adjudication, authorization when applicable, and blocked conformance decision.
Record source and historical projection hashes.

failure_conditions: Any source requirement is absent or duplicated.
Any source applicability or finding status changes.
Any source claim, evidence, endpoint, gap, strongest supported claim, prohibited inference, or bounded decision is lost.
The migrated instance fails v4.2 schema or semantic validation.
